requirements.statement: Shoppers can browse the product catalog

criteria.must: The catalog page lists available products
Each listed product shows at least its name and price

requirements.statement: Shoppers can view a single product's details

criteria.must: Opening a product shows its photos, description, price, and stock availability

requirements.statement: Shoppers can search and filter the catalog

criteria.must: Searching by keyword returns only matching products
Filtering by category returns only products in that category

requirements.statement: Shoppers can add a product to their cart and adjust quantities

criteria.must: Adding a product to the cart increases the cart's item count
Changing an item's quantity in the cart updates its subtotal

requirements.statement: Shoppers can view and edit their cart before checkout

criteria.must: The cart view lists every added item with price and quantity
Removing an item from the cart removes it from the displayed list

requirements.statement: Shoppers can check out as a guest without creating an account

criteria.must: A shopper who is not signed in can complete checkout and receive an order

requirements.statement: Shoppers can sign in via SSO

criteria.must: A shopper can sign in through the Thunder SSO flow

requirements.statement: Shoppers can pay by card at checkout

criteria.must: Checkout accepts card payment details and completes the purchase on success
A declined card payment prevents order creation and surfaces an error

requirements.statement: Shoppers see a flat shipping fee (or free shipping) at checkout before paying

criteria.must: The checkout total displayed includes the shipping fee before payment is submitted

requirements.statement: Shoppers receive an order confirmation after checkout

criteria.must: A completed checkout shows an order confirmation with the purchased items
The wording and clarity of the confirmation is easy for a shopper to understand

requirements.statement: Signed-in shoppers can view their order history

criteria.must: A signed-in shopper's order history lists their own past orders
A signed-in shopper cannot view another shopper's orders

requirements.statement: The Store Admin signs in via SSO to manage the store

criteria.must: Admin management screens are inaccessible without a Store Admin sign-in
A Store Admin can sign in through the Thunder SSO flow

requirements.statement: The Store Admin can create, edit, and retire products including price, description, photos, and stock level

criteria.must: The admin can create a new product with name, price, description, and stock level
The admin can edit an existing product's fields
The admin can retire a product so it no longer appears in the shopper catalog

requirements.statement: The Store Admin is warned when a product's stock runs low or out

criteria.must: A product at or below its low-stock threshold is visibly flagged to the admin
A product with zero stock is visibly flagged as out of stock to the admin

requirements.statement: The Store Admin can view incoming orders and mark them fulfilled/shipped

criteria.must: The admin order view lists incoming orders with their status
The admin can mark an order as fulfilled/shipped, and its status updates accordingly

requirements.statement: The store is a single-seller storefront, not a multi-vendor marketplace

criteria.must: All products in the catalog belong to the same single store, with no per-seller attribution or onboarding flow
